thread:
Sara (Sales): heads up — BlueHarbor is ready to move to a POC. They need streaming + tool calls + strict JSON schema enforcement. big ask: Go SDK, sustained ~200 qps, bursts to ~1k, data residency EU. Help?
Devin (Solutions Eng): thanks — can you paste their primary flows? sync convo or async webhooks? any function call latency SLAs?
Sara (Sales): primary flow is interactive chat -> model may call their order system via toolcall 'order_tool'. they want deterministic JSON output (no prose) for downstream parsers. prefer streaming so product sees incremental tokens. latency target p95 < 250ms for short prompts.
Mira (Infra): EU data residency -> private VPC or Dedicated in eu-west region. if they want customer-managed KMS we can do Private. is on-prem required or just VPC?
Sara (Sales): VPC is fine. customer wants BYOK (bring-your-own-key) and audit logs. also SOC2 questions still open.
Paul (Platform Eng): quick notes — Dedicated reserved pool can handle sustained 200 qps with headroom; bursts to 1k need burst capacity or autoscale bump. for strict JSON we recommend:
```
- use structured output + schema validation layer on the SDK side
- enable response_schema with "enforce":true so runtime drops nonconforming tokens
```
Streaming + toolcall: we support streamed function call events (partial args) and final complete call. KV cache will help for repeated prefixes. fallback plan: route to a cheaper quantized variant if primary nodes saturated.
Devin (Solutions Eng): Go SDK specifics — we have a streaming client example that emits partial events and a final toolcall object. share snippet?
Paul (Platform Eng): paste example: 
```go
client.Stream(ctx, req, func(evt Event){
  if evt.Type == EventFunctionCall {
    // accumulate args until complete then call their order API
  }
})
```
Also recommend setting request.meta.max_tokens and response.schema to avoid hallucinations.
Mira (Infra): for KMS we support customer KMS via Private; HSM option on enterprise contract. network wise place NAT + private endpoints in their VPC, we can do IP allowlist or TI-delegation.
sec-bot: security checklist: https://redwood.internal/sec-checks/presales-poc — please complete: data flows, encryption-at-rest, key custody, pen-test windows, SSO (SAML/OIDC). I flagged SOC2 gap for backup retention policy.
Sara (Sales): copying BlueHarbor contact (they asked for an ops runbook + pricing estimate). can we get a price sketch for Dedicated monthly + burst?
Devin (Solutions Eng): estimate: baseline reserved for 200 qps (n GPU units) ~$Xk/month, burst tier add-on ~+30% during trial. I'll put concrete numbers in a follow-up.
Paul (Platform Eng): operational runbook suggestions: canary with 10% traffic -> 50% -> full. define fallback: degrade to 4bit quantized variant and notify via webhook. include telemetry hooks for token-level cost sampling.
Sara (Sales): timeline — customer wants a 2-week POC. can we turn up a sandbox with VPC + test KMS in that window?
Mira (Infra): yes, we can provision a Private sandbox in eu-west with test keys in ~4 business days. will need an onboarding checklist from sales with contact and IP ranges.
Devin (Solutions Eng): I'll schedule a 30-min tech sync with BlueHarbor and infra + eng. suggested agenda: flows, schema sample, QPS patterns, auth/KMS, success criteria.
Sara (Sales): perfect. BlueHarbor ops are available tomorrow 10:30 CET. I'll book and add agenda. thanks all :thumbsup:
Paul (Platform Eng): leaving a note — watch out for long-running toolcalls that call internal endpoints; recommend circuit breakers + timeout 2s per external call.
Mira (Infra): adding docs link for VPC onboarding: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-onboard.
Sara (Sales): ok shared calendar invite, will attach schema sample and SOC2 questions. let's keep thread for async notes.
Devin (Solutions Eng): I'll post the Go SDK streaming example and the pricing sketch here after the call.
sec-bot: reminder in 24h to upload completed security checklist.
Sara (Sales): thanks everyone, tagging for follow-ups: @Devin (Solutions Eng) @Mira (Infra) @Paul (Platform Eng)
